name: Invokely
description: Query official statistics through Invokely's hosted MCP server. Statistics values include publisher source details and a ready-made citation.
notes: Both endpoints advertise the same 11 tools: six statistics query tools and five account-scoped workspace tools. The no-account trial is limited to 25 calls per day per IP. Workspace calls require account authentication; saving or updating items also requires Pro. workspace_delete is irreversible. Citations apply to statistics values, not user-supplied workspace datasets. Clients that do not apply a tool filter may expose the workspace tools.
installHint: Both endpoints return the full tool list. The no-account trial is limited to 25 calls per day per IP; the API-key option sends an Invokely key as a Bearer token. In OpenHands Agent Canvas, after connecting, create a named OpenHands Agent Profile, choose tools, select search_indicators, resolve_place, get_value, get_series, compare, and rank_places, and leave the five workspace_* tools deselected. This selection applies only to that profile; the default/global profile does not restrict the list. Other clients may offer their own tool filters.

auth.credentialHelp: Create an API key in your Invokely account. It is sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
